content.raw:
What is new in 1.2

This post is laid out with Elementor's containers. It follows the 1.1 notes.

Faster

Pages are cached per site.

Safer

Uploads are checked by their bytes.

Easier

Get the guide https://vimeo.com/76979871http://localhost:8089/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/sample.mp4 [caption width="300"] The cover image[/caption]
